$comment: TranSafe MCP gateway — stdio connection config for Tencent WorkBuddy (also works
unchanged in Claude Desktop, which reads the same mcpServers shape).
WorkBuddy reads this from ~/.workbuddy-ai/mcp.json — note 'mcp.json', NOT
'.mcp.json'. A config at the wrong path fails silently: the server never appears.
Merge the block below into the EXISTING mcpServers object rather than replacing
the file, or you will clobber other servers you have configured.
Saving is not enough: WorkBuddy ships custom MCP servers DISABLED. Restart it,
open connector management, find the custom connectors entry at the top-right,
and click Trust on 'transafe'. Until you do, no tool call reaches TranSafe.
Replace <ABS_PATH> with the absolute path to this repository's backend/ directory.
TRANSAFE_ROLE is the process-level entitlement CEILING. A tools/call argument may
name a NARROWER role (useful for previewing redaction), but never a broader one.
Launching with 'public' and asking for 'fraud_ops' gets you 'public'.
Valid roles: fraud_ops, compliance, customer_service, legal, auditor, analyst,
partner_bank, external_researcher, public. Anything else is treated as public.
Every call — success, denial, rate limit, error — is written to mcp_access_log and
emitted as an exposure/mcp_call ns_event, visible live on console Screen G.

transafe.description: TranSafe fraud intelligence — role-redacted campaigns, cases, indicators and defense artifacts.
